eras.label: Single-month snapshot, no signal
eras.focus: The available data covers only January 2026, with 320 papers all grouped under 'Other' and no extractable contribution summaries. There is insufficient information to identify distinct problem focuses or influential representative works. A single era is therefore defined spanning the entire observed window.

fieldNarrative: The dataset provides only one month of coverage (January 2026) with 320 papers, no thematic thread labels beyond 'Other', and empty contribution summaries, so no temporal evolution can be reconstructed. No labs can be traced because no organizational attribution is present in the data. With a single time point, there are no era-to-era shifts, driving problems, or discernible trajectories to narrate. A meaningful field narrative would require a longer time span, labeled research threads, and per-paper contribution or affiliation metadata. As it stands, the field appears as an undifferentiated snapshot rather than an evolving research landscape.
